market_note: Tether shed roughly $5.4B in market cap over 60 days as Revolut's USDT delisting deadline (Aug 31) and a new Big Four reserve audit loom.

stablecoin_items.headline: Treasury's GENIUS Act rules add criminal teeth; Tether faces $47B reserve fix
stablecoin_items.summary: A new Treasury NPRM defines who may legally issue or sell stablecoins, with fines up to $1M and 5 years in prison per violation. Tether is restructuring reserves and hired a Big Four auditor for its first full audit.

stablecoin_items.headline: Circle shares fall 20% on stablecoin reward-limit fears
stablecoin_items.summary: Circle stock dropped sharply on concerns over looming limits on stablecoin holder rewards, even as Tether faces wallet freezes and its own reserve overhaul.

stablecoin_items.headline: Wyoming's WYST targets Aug 20 mainnet launch
stablecoin_items.summary: The Wyoming Stable Token Commission is targeting today for the mainnet launch of WYST, the first US state-issued stablecoin.

stablecoin_items.headline: OCC clears World Liberty Trust to issue USD1; MoonPay opens PYUSDx launchpad
stablecoin_items.summary: The OCC gave preliminary approval (Aug 14) for World Liberty Trust Company to issue USD1 under federal oversight, while MoonPay opened a launchpad letting developers issue PYUSD-backed stablecoins.

hack_items.headline: Coldcard hardware wallet exploit tops $130M
hack_items.summary: Attackers exploited a five-year-old firmware flaw in Coinkite's Coldcard wallets, draining 1,816 BTC from 5,200 addresses — the third-largest crypto hack of 2026.

hack_items.headline: Maya Protocol loses ~$11M in liquidity-pool exploit
hack_items.summary: Six chained flaws let an attacker credit nearly 50 million tokens to a pool without proper funding on Aug 19, draining roughly $11M in value.

hack_items.headline: Crypto thefts hit $163M in August as hacker tactics shift
hack_items.summary: Monthly theft totals climbed to $163M, with attackers moving away from smart-contract bugs toward wallet and key-management exploits.

hack_items.headline: 2026 hack losses pass $1.2B across 276 incidents
hack_items.summary: Year-to-date crypto theft has topped $1.2 billion, with North Korea-linked groups reportedly responsible for roughly two-thirds of stolen funds.
